subject: Request: Proof-of-Fix & PT verification window for FinSolve integration
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsolve.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Proof-of-Fix & PT verification window for FinSolve integration

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the detailed PT report. Our engineering team shipped the fixes outlined in sections 2.1–2.4 (session handling, CVE mitigation, and improved logging) and tagged the rollout yesterday. I attached a short remediation summary and supporting screenshots for the changes we made.

Can RedTeam Labs and FinSolve confirm a retest window for validation? Our preferred windows are Mar 29 or Mar 30 (US Pacific). We can provide temporary test accounts and a short list of endpoints to validate (see remediation_summary_20270325.pdf).

Attachments: remediation_summary_20270325.pdf (pdf), remediation_screenshots_20270325.zip (zip)

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm retest scope (we recommend a focused delta test on the remediated flows)
- Agree on redaction rules for the public report (we will need an attested, redacted PDF for FinSolve and an internal full report)
- If retest passes, we'd ask for a short verification letter or attestation noting the delta fixes and date tested

Looping in Karthik and Marissa for compliance sign-off and to coordinate evidence collection.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsolve.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finsolve.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Proof-of-Fix & PT verification window for FinSolve integration

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the quick turnaround from your team.

We can do an initial delta retest on Mar 29 between 09:00–12:00 PT. A couple of asks before we confirm:
1) Please provide temporary test credentials and an allowlist of IPs for the testing tools.
2) We need access to the remediation changelog (commit ids or ticket references) so our engineers can verify the specific fixes.
3) For the public attestation, FinSolve requires explicit language confirming which CVEs were addressed and the retest date.

If RedTeam Labs is coordinating the retest, please confirm they can run within that window and will produce both a redacted report for external use and a full technical appendix for FinSolve's internal review.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Security
FinSolve, Inc.
alex.turner@finsolve.com
From: RedTeam Labs <ops@redteamlabs.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsolve.com>
Cc: security@finsolve.com
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Proof-of-Fix & PT verification window for FinSolve integration

Hi Naomi / Alex —

RedTeam Labs can take the retest on Mar 29 09:00–12:00 PT. We will perform a delta-focused validation limited to the fixes called out in your remediation_summary_20270325.pdf. Our deliverables for this engagement:

- RedTeam delta verification report (redacted PDF suitable for public sharing)
- Technical appendix (full report, with logs and PoC artifacts) delivered under NDA to the FinSolve security contacts
- Short verification letter (one page) with a pass/fail statement referencing the specific issues rechecked and the date tested

Please provide: temporary test accounts, allowlisted IPs, and a brief changelog (ticket ids or commit refs) no later than EOD Mar 28 so we can prep. We will retain raw logs for 30 days and include a signed statement on testing methodology.

Regards,
Priya Nadarajah
Engagement Lead
RedTeam Labs

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Quick update — retest completed this morning (Mar 30). RedTeam confirmed the delta verification passed on the remediated flows; they delivered the redacted report and a verification letter. I attached the redacted report and the proof_of_fix_signoff.docx for FinSolve signature.

Action items for our side:
- Karthik: please review the redacted report and confirm we can sign the attestation language (I highlighted the wording we should avoid).
- Marissa: will you drop the redacted PDF into the compliance evidence folder and add a short entry to the SOC 2 evidence log?
- Jordan: can you coordinate the DocuSign for the one-page verification letter to FinSolve? I included the DocuSign link below.

Attachments: redteam_retest_report_redacted.pdf, proof_of_fix_signoff.docx
